{{Top|leg}}
'''Compart Corporation''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]-run corporation that was based in the [[city/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], a colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] in [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

It mass-produced various types of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] circuitry and components, specializing in the finer elements, such as circuitry used to manufacture [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], fingers and other fine movements, an important element in the development process of droids. As such, it often had contracts with [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="guide" />
